data_sources.name: topic ideas
data_sources.script:
import json
# Suggestions for the Suggest button. A JSON array becomes a popover of
# choices; each entry's 'topic' fills the field and 'hook' is the muted
# second line. Static here so the button costs nothing to press — swap in
# fetch_url and this becomes "debate what is on the front page today".
print(json.dumps([
    {"topic": "Should we adopt a monorepo?", "hook": "build times against release independence"},
    {"topic": "Is a four-day week worth the coordination cost?", "hook": "output per hour against availability"},
    {"topic": "Should this service own its own database?", "hook": "autonomy against the cost of a second source of truth"}
]))

sections.html:
<script>
// Registered BEFORE the pipeline section mounts, because the panel copies
// the renderer registry at mount time. A renderer added later is silently
// ignored: the cards render in the default style and nothing errors.
//
// A block's type is the STAGE KIND that produced it, so every worker stage
// arrives as 'worker'. The stage NAME comes through as the title, which is
// what tells the verdict apart from the positions.
window.uiRegisterBlockRenderer('worker', function(d) {
  var accent = d.title === 'judge' ? '#6366f1' : '#8b949e';
  var wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'border-left:3px solid ' + accent + ';padding:2px 0 2px 12px;margin:10px 0';
  var head = document.createElement('div');
  head.style.cssText = 'font:600 12px/1.6 ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:' + accent;
  head.textContent = d.title || 'stage';
  var body = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.appendChild(head);
  wrap.appendChild(body);
  return {wrap: wrap, body: body};
});

// The Export button. A client action is looked up at CLICK time, so this one
// is not order-sensitive the way the renderer above is.
window.uiRegisterClientAction('debate_export', function(ctx) {
  window.print();
});
</script>
